prompt_text: I am planning a trip. Should I book on Airbnb, Vrbo, or Booking.com, and how do I find a good host?
ai_overview_text:
You should choose Airbnb for unique apartments or local experiences, Vrbo for entire private homes with families or groups, and Booking.com for flexible hotel-style stays or instant-booking properties with minimal host interaction.
Platform Comparison
FeatureAirbnbVrboBooking.comBest ForApartments, spare rooms, unique stays, city tripsEntire houses, villas, family beach/mountain tripsHotels, apartments, last-minute staysFeesVariable guest service fee (usually up to 14%)Service fee plus separate property feesUsually no guest service fee (set by property)CancellationVaries by host (Flexible to Strict)Varies by host/property managerOften free cancellation up to days beforeInventoryHigh share of individual hosts and shared spacesExclusively entire homes/no shared spacesMix of apartments, hotels, and resorts
Look for Superhosts or Premier Hosts: Search for designations like Airbnb Superhost or Vrbo Premier Host, which mean the host has high ratings, a low cancellation rate, and a proven track record.
Read Recent Reviews: Filter reviews by the last 6 to 12 months to check the current state of cleanliness, communication, and accuracy of the listing.
Check Response Rate and Time: Choose hosts who respond quickly (usually within an hour) and answer your specific pre-booking questions politely and clearly.
Read the Full House Rules: Reliable hosts outline strict, clear expectations regarding noise, parking, and checkout procedures to protect both parties.
What type of destination (city, beach, remote cabin) are you visiting?
Are you traveling solo, as a couple, or with a large family/group?
